change_summary: The correction says the effect size in Table 2 was reported incorrectly because of a calculation error. The correct value is d = 0.8 (95% CI 0.5 to 1.1), not d = 1.8, while the stored paper reported a large effect with d = 1.8 (95% CI 1.4 to 2.2). The notice says the direction of the effect and the conclusion that training reduced anxiety are unchanged. So a headline number changes substantially, but the main conclusion is said to stand.
evaluation: Your Introduction cites [12] as finding a large effect (d = 1.8), and uses it to expect that mindfulness will strongly reduce anxiety. The notice says the direction of the effect and the conclusion that training reduced anxiety are unchanged. Overall the impact on your draft is medium.
